items.Sentence: The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system, a screenings washer, and a metering flume.
The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system, a screenings washer, and a metering flume.
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.

The pond has a volumetric capacity of 2.93 million gallons, and is divided into three baffled cells... the third cell contains a 3-horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond.

The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes... Wastewater from the settling pond is recirculated to the aeration pond as necessary.
the secondary effluent is pre-chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite prior to filtration.

Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system. The microfiltration system consists of two treatment trains each with a holding tank, strainer, and three banks of 12 microza microfiltration modules.
The microfiltration building has been designed to accommodate a third treatment train if necessary.
A chlorine gas system was replaced with a sodium hypochlorite system in May 2014.

Sodium hypochlorite is injected into the 8-inch influent line prior to entering the chlorine contact tank... a final chlorine residual of 4.3 mg/L is needed to maintain a contact time of 450 mg-min/L at peak weekly design flow.
before discharge to the effluent storage pond, the chlorinated effluent is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite.

After treatment, the advanced treated effluent is discharged to an on-site effluent storage pond prior to discharge to the recycled water system or the surface water discharge system. The maximum capacity of the existing on-site storage pond is 3.25 million gallons.
Biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion and densification.
approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
